Helicopter CH-47C 67-18536

Unit: A/159 AVN
Casualties = 05 KIA . .
Incident number: 69041810.KIA
UTM grid coordinates: YC675837 (map lookup key: Grid Reference 48QYC675837)
Date: 04/18/1969
South Vietnam
The helicopter Continued Flight. Aircraft Destroyed.
Ultimate crash and burn (it stayed airborne for a short while, then came down burning).
War Story: Hit the trees, lost its blades, impacted a hillside and broke in half. A CH-47 resupplying FSB LASH (YC670667) took ground fire 5 km north of the base. The pilot dropped the load, turned north and was crashing at YC675837 near FSB THOR (YC659837).
